## Checklist

- [ ] `swift test` passes, run from `swift/`
- [ ] New source files in `Sources/NumidentViewer` or `Sources/NumidentCore` are added to the Xcode project
- [ ] The change works on macOS 13+ and on Intel, with no Electron, web views, Metal, custom drawing or animations
- [ ] It adds no third-party dependencies or secrets, or this PR explains why it must
- [ ] It adds no data files, real records, real names or SSNs
- [ ] It adds nothing resembling the SSA seal, and implies no connection to SSA or NARA
- [ ] Docs and the [wiki](https://github.com/scotCW/NUMIDENT-viewer/wiki) are updated, or no update is needed
